function.name: enhance_prompt
function.description: Author or adapt a directly runnable image, video, or image-edit prompt in an exact active model's native format. Use this when the requested text deliverable is explicitly a prompt for a named media model, including a commercial prompt; always pass destination_model and the matching target_output. Unknown, sunset, or omitted models fail closed. Do not use for lyrics, music composition, screenplays, storyboards, treatments, or ad scripts.

prompt.description: The source prompt, rough idea, or prompt revision request to enhance.

target_output.description: The model-specific prompt artifact to produce. Use model_prompt only when destination_model unambiguously identifies the modality.

destination_model.description: Required exact active destination model selector, such as seedance2, ltx25, ltx23, wan22, minimax-h3-turbo, qwen, gpt-image-2, krea-2-turbo, chroma-v46-flash, or sdxl. Unknown and sunset models fail closed.

destination_tool.description: Optional downstream generation tool, such as generate_image, edit_image, generate_video, animate_photo, sound_to_video, or video_to_video.

prompting_type.description: Deprecated compatibility metadata. It never selects or overrides the prompt grammar; destination_model is authoritative.

model_title.description: Deprecated compatibility label. It never selects or overrides the prompt grammar; destination_model is authoritative.

style_prompt.description: Optional current style, brand, or prompt context to complement without repeating.

duration_seconds.description: Requested runtime when authoring a video prompt.

aspect_ratio.description: Optional target aspect ratio, such as 16:9, 9:16, 1:1, 4:5, or 21:9.

assets.description: Optional available assets the authored prompt may reference. The selected exact model contract applies its per-modality and total limits.

constraints.description: Optional production, brand, model, or user constraints to preserve.

function.name: compose_lyrics
function.description: Compose vocal song lyrics and suggested musical parameters. Use for songs with words, choruses, verses, jingles, vocal hooks, or lyric rewrites. Do not use for instrumental-only music.

prompt.description: The song topic, mood, genre, scene, campaign, or lyric request.

language.description: Optional language code or language name for the lyrics.

music_prompt.description: Optional musical style context, genre, instrumentation, mood, or production direction.

duration_seconds.description: Optional desired song duration in seconds.

function.name: compose_instrumental
function.description: Compose an instrumental music structure and suggested musical parameters. Use for background scores, beds, cues, themes, and music requests without lyrics.

prompt.description: The instrumental music topic, mood, genre, scene, campaign, or composition request.

music_prompt.description: Optional musical style context, instrumentation, mood, or production direction.

duration_seconds.description: Optional desired track duration in seconds.

function.name: compose_script
function.description: Compose scripts, screenplays, storyboards, treatments, ad concepts, trailers, social shorts, campaign beats, and talking-head plans. Use for creative-writing artifacts that are not directly runnable model prompts. When the user explicitly asks for a prompt for a named image or video model, use enhance_prompt instead, even if the prompt is for a commercial. Do not use for lyrics.

brief.description: The creative writing brief, story idea, product concept, video idea, or revision request.

script_type.description: The kind of script or creative writing artifact to produce.

destination_model.description: Optional destination video model selector, such as ltx23, wan22, or seedance2.

destination_tool.description: Optional downstream tool, such as generate_video, animate_photo, sound_to_video, or video_to_video.

duration_seconds.description: Requested runtime for a video prompt, social short, ad, or talking-head script.

scene_count.description: Requested number of scenes, shots, beats, or storyboard panels.

aspect_ratio.description: Optional target aspect ratio, such as 16:9, 9:16, 1:1, 4:5, or 21:9.

platform.description: Optional target platform or context, such as TikTok, YouTube Shorts, Instagram Reels, broadcast, landing page, game trailer, or pitch deck.

style.description: Optional style, genre, tone, visual treatment, or brand voice to preserve.

first_frame_description.description: Optional description of the starting frame when composing an image-to-video prompt without attached vision content.

first_frame_data_url.description: Optional inline image data URI for the starting frame when composing an image-to-video or first-frame video prompt.

last_frame_data_url.description: Optional inline image data URI for the ending frame when composing an image-to-video transition prompt.

return_format.description: Requested output format. Use script unless structured planning output is explicitly needed.

function.name: compose_workflow
function.description:
Compose a runnable durable creative workflow plan from a creative brief. Returns a validated `steps[]` array (the same shape accepted by `POST /v1/creative-agent/workflows`) plus a capacity-units estimate.

Call this tool — do NOT describe the plan in chat text — when the user asks for any of: "a runnable workflow plan", "a plan I can submit", "compile a workflow / pipeline", "a multi-step plan", "a one-shot plan", or names a structural shape like "N-shot teaser, [aspect], [duration]" (e.g. "5-shot product teaser, 9:16, 15s"). The plain-text description of stages is never the right output for those requests — the validated `steps[]` array is the contract.

Use `compose_workflow_template` instead when the user wants to SAVE the plan as a reusable template (different surface: typed `inputs[]` plus `template_draft`). Use `compose_script` for creative writing artifacts (scripts, lyrics, scene beats) that are NOT a workflow plan. The returned plan is not idempotent; pair the eventual `POST /v1/creative-agent/workflows` submission with your own `Idempotency-Key`.

brief.description: Creative brief describing what the workflow should produce. Free-form natural language. Required.

scene_count.description: Suggested number of distinct shots/scenes. The planner may produce more steps than scenes (e.g., keyframe + clip per scene).

duration_seconds.description: Target total duration in seconds for video-bearing plans.

style.description: Optional stylistic guidance (e.g., 'cinematic, neon, low-key', 'whiteboard illustration').

max_estimated_capacity_units.description: If set, the planner attempts to keep total estimated cost at or below this value and returns `fits_budget: false` if it cannot.

include_audio.description: If true, include a music generation step. Defaults to false.

return_format.description: Currently `json` is the only supported value. Reserved for future.

function.name: compose_workflow_template
function.description:
Compose OR EDIT a savable, parameterized workflow template plus a concrete example plan. Returns a `template_draft` (typed `inputs[]`, parameterized `stages[]` referencing `$inputs.<name>`, optional `graph` layout) alongside a Phase-1-compatible `plan` for example inputs.

Use for both: (1) creating a NEW named, reusable workflow in the builder UI, AND (2) EDITING a SAVED workflow the user references by name or id (e.g. "edit my bobblehead workflow", "change my saved storyboard template to 16:9", "add a music step to wf_X", "swap the model in my saved template"). For saved-template edits, pass the prior template JSON as `existing_template` so the planner preserves stage ids and bumps only the requested change.

Do NOT use individual creative tools (generate_image, edit_image, animate_photo, generate_video, etc.) when the user is editing a SAVED workflow — those produce one-shot media, not template changes. Do NOT use `compose_workflow` for saved-template edits; that is for one-shot plans only.

The returned template is a draft; the caller is responsible for saving it via `POST /v1/creative-agent/workflows/templates`.

brief.description: Creative brief describing what the workflow should produce. Free-form natural language. Required.

name.description: Human-readable template name (e.g. "My Plastic Dream — TikTok/Reels"). Required.

description.description: Optional template description. If omitted, the planner may derive one from the brief.

category.description: Optional category for surfacing the template in the library. Defaults to 'custom' when omitted.

visibility.description: Persistence visibility. Defaults to 'private'. The 'team' visibility is reserved for a later milestone.

inputs.description: Optional typed input declarations. When omitted, the planner LLM proposes inputs based on the brief.

name.description: Input name; used as the placeholder key (e.g. $inputs.motion_source_video).

type.description: Input value type. URL string for image/audio/video; primitive for the rest.

required.description: Whether the input must be supplied at run time. Defaults to false.

description.description: Human-readable description shown in the launcher UI.

default.description: Optional default value. Type must match `type`.

multiple.description: Set when the input accepts an array of values.

internal.description: Internal inputs are seeded at run-create time and hidden from the launcher UI.

scene_count.description: Suggested number of distinct shots/scenes. The planner may produce more steps than scenes (e.g., keyframe + clip per scene).

duration_seconds.description: Target total duration in seconds for video-bearing plans.

style.description: Optional stylistic guidance (e.g., 'cinematic, neon, low-key', 'whiteboard illustration').

max_estimated_capacity_units.description: If set, the planner attempts to keep total estimated cost at or below this value and returns `fits_budget: false` if it cannot.

include_audio.description: If true, include a music generation step. Defaults to false.

return_format.description: Currently `json` is the only supported value. Reserved for future.

existing_template.description: Optional full WorkflowTemplate JSON the caller wants the planner to edit. When supplied, the planner treats the supplied template as the starting point and the brief as the modification request: it preserves unchanged stages and inputs, applies the requested edits, bumps the template version, and keeps stage ids stable unless the brief explicitly renames them. Use for 'add a music step', 'switch the storyboard model to GPT Image 2', 'make this 9:16 instead of 16:9' style edits.
